api:
OV.GeoUI.model gains three functions:
- busyDest(G, craft, target?) → {ref, stake: 'terror'|'mission'|'other', points, leftS} | null. Returns null when the craft is free, returning, in the hangar, or already heading to target.
- headingText(G, ref) → «a caminho do ataque em X» / «a caminho do OVNI-n» / «a caminho da base alienígena (P)».
- ammoSuggest(G, baseId, itemId) → {qty, clip, have, coming}. qty fills every weapon at that base that uses this ammo and adds one full reload per weapon, minus what is in stores or already ordered. It is at least 1 and never more than the funds can pay for.

Other GeoUI.model changes:
- busyLine(G, craftId, ref) is exported.
- nightAt(G, ref) now also returns dusk:true at dusk; before, it returned null.
- craftsFor rows gain busy:0|1. With a target, free transports sort before busy ones.

OV.BaseUI.open(G, baseId, tab, {pick?, item?, qty?, equip?}): qty pre-sets the Market buy quantity on the highlighted row.

OV.CampaignUI.alsoPromotedKey(n, allFemale) → i18n key for «Também promovido/a/os/as na base».

OV.BattleUI.model.turnReportRows(entries, endNo?): the new endNo argument splits the report into three sections in this order: end of the X-COM turn, the alien turn, start of the next X-COM turn.

Log entries now carry seq, plus end:true for anything logged after «Fim do turno» but before the alien turn.

New i18n keys:
- pt-PT.hud: hud.report.turnEnd, hud.report.alienTurn, hud.report.title.since, hud.log.how.alienGrenade, hud.log.how.alienGrenadeBy, hud.log.turnEnd.
- pt-PT.geoui: geo.int.heading.{site,alienBase,ufo}, geo.int.busy.{terror,mission}, geo.ev.team.busy, geo.ev.team.busy.terror, geo.int.divert.{title,now,terror,mission,keep,go}, geo.ev.arrived.dusk(.safe/.crash), geo.int.noAmmo.clip, geo.int.noAmmo.suggest.one/.other, geo.int.noAmmo.coming.one/.other, geo.a.buyAmmoN.
- pt-PT.base: base.market.clip.
- Gender variants: scr.db.promoted.f, cp.br.warn.heavy.f, cp.db.alsoPromoted.{one,one.f,other,other.f}.

Keys split into .one/.other plurals:
- pt-PT.base: base.pers.{fit,wounded,free,busy}, base.stores.{items,kinds}, base.crafts.{n,cap}, base.sol.n, base.prod.sub.
- pt-PT.geoui: geo.i.craftsN, geo.int.readyN, geo.fix.noTroops, geo.ev.arrived.mission.body.
- pt-PT.hud: hud.med.wounds, hud.medk.charges, hud.medk.partSel, hud.medk.partBtn, hud.equip.missing.
- pt-PT.screens: scr.qb.squadN.
- pt-PT.ufopaedia: up.locked.
summary:
I re-checked all 5 casual-player findings against the current code. None was fully fixed by round 3, so all 5 are now fixed at the root, each with a regression check. `node tools/test.js --strict --i18n` passes 745/745; the only missing-key line it prints is the built-in `nao.existe.x` probe.

QA results:
- New `qa/persona_r3_casual.mjs`: 64/64 checks.
- All 16 required QA scripts pass, plus `integration_r3`, `ufopaedia_check` and `full_campaign` (exit 0, 0 confusing moments).
- Three scripts failed on the first run and pass on re-run:
  - `persona_r1_battle` expected the old cause text; I updated it.
  - `geo_check` assumed Enter starts the mission even when the arrival is at night and Enter means «Esperar pelo dia» (the round-3 shell fix). It now presses I («Atacar já») in that case.
  - `dogfight_check` failed one timing check («Esc minimiza») while other QA ran at the same time; it passed alone and I did not change dogfight code.
- I looked at every changed screen at 1440×900, 1024×576 and iPad 1194×834 (turn report, message log, «OVNI aterrou», «Enviar equipa», the divert question, dusk arrival, ammo popup, Market, debrief «Promovida a», Pessoal). Screenshots are in `/tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HelloWorld/b8cfbac1-629a-5f58-8dfb-0f752cc84b7c/scratchpad/ui4/persona_r3_casual/`.

**(a) Deaths at the end of the X-COM turn — fixed.**
- Round 3 already listed these deaths, but under «No início do turno X-COM», which is the wrong moment.
- The turn report now has the sections in order: «No fim do turno X-COM — rebentaram granadas», «Durante o turno alienígena», «No início do turno X-COM».
- When there are end-of-turn rows, the report title becomes «Desde o fim do seu turno».
- The cause now reads «granada alienígena» (or «granada alienígena (Sectoide)» once the alien was seen) instead of «explosão (atacante não visto)».
- The message log (N) labels these entries «Turno N — fim do turno X-COM (granadas)».
- I also fixed a related silent loss: the log keeps only 400 entries, so in long battles some of the turn's entries could drop out of the report. It now uses a running number instead of a list position.
- The Node test runs the real engine: an alien grenade with fuse 0 under a soldier, then «Fim do turno». It checks that every one of our entries reaches the report.

**(b) Busy transport — fixed.**
- «OVNI aterrou» and the terror-site ETA line now add «Atenção: Skyranger-1 já segue a caminho do ataque em Budapeste — mandar a equipa para aqui deixa esse ataque sem resposta (−500 pontos)».
- In «Enviar equipa» the craft row shows «· a caminho do ataque em …» with a red note giving the cost. Free transports are listed before busy ones.
- Choosing a busy craft asks «Desviar Skyranger-1?», naming who goes unanswered, the points and the time left. «Manter rumo» is the Enter/Esc default; «Desviar mesmo assim» is the danger button.
- The same question appears whether the player picks the craft first, picks the target first, or clicks the globe. A transport with its squad heading to another ground mission gets a milder warning.

**(c) Dusk arrival — fixed, with one deviation (see deviations).**
- The arrival popup now treats dusk like night: a warning line, the «Esperar pelo dia» button, the fuel warning, and the same crash/safe text variants.
- The text is truthful: soldiers still see 20 tiles at dusk, as by day. That matches the briefing's own dusk note, so the briefing no longer surprises.
- If the dawn re-prompt fires while it is still dusk, the title no longer says «Amanheceu».
- Attacking at dusk does not count as the first night mission.

**(d) Gender and plurals — fixed, with a sweep of the pt-PT files.**
- Debrief now says «Promovida a …» for female soldiers (campaign and Quick Battle).
- The production and delivery popups use neutral wording.
- «1 apto · 1 ferido», «1 livre · 1 ocupado» and «1 nave · 1 hangar» now use proper plurals.
- The sweep also fixed, among others: the Soldiers tab header, stores counts, «com 1 soldado pronto», «1 pronta», medkit «1 ferida» / «1 carga», «Falta 1 objeto», Ufopédia «1 artigo», and «Também promovida(s)».

**(e) Interceptor ammo — fixed, rearm rule unchanged.**
- Whole-box rearm is faithful to the original (OpenXcom rounds up to whole clips, and CAMPAIGN_API §… describes it), so I did not change the rule.
- The «Intercetor sem munição» popup now explains that each rearm uses whole boxes of 50. It suggests a quantity with its cost (e.g. «comprar 9 ($11 160)»: enough to fill the base's cannons plus one reserve reload, minus stock and boxes already ordered, capped by funds).
- The button reads «Comprar munição (×9)» and opens the Market with 9 already set on the highlighted row. The «sem munição» confirmation does the same.
- The Market's craft-ammo row now explains the boxes.

To match the new behaviour I updated older checks: 5 Node tests, `persona_r1_battle.mjs` and `geo_check.mjs`.
deviations: (c) At dusk, «Esperar pelo dia» is offered but not made the Enter default. waitIsDefault returns false for dusk; at night it behaves exactly as before. Reason: SHADE_DUSK 6 ≤ DARK_SHADE 9, so at dusk no tile is «escuro» for X-COM sight (los.js canSeeCore) and soldiers see 20 tiles, as by day. Defaulting to wait would cost hours and risk the UFO lifting off for no gain, and saying dusk is as dangerous as night would be false. The popup says this truthfully and keeps the fuel and crash-expiry logic. A Node test pins the rule to the tuning, so if dusk is ever made dark, wait becomes the default again automatically.

(e) The rearm rule is unchanged. Whole boxes are faithful to the original and to CAMPAIGN_API §11 (rearmPerHour using ammoItem from stores), so only the explanation and the suggested quantity are new.

A few strings were reworded to be neutral rather than split into plurals: base.prod.done is now «Progresso {done}/{qty}», base.prod.contDone is «Contínuo · fabricados: {n}», geo.ev.delivery.item is «{n} × {item} ({base}).» and geo.ev.productionDone.body is «Encomenda terminada: {qty} × {item} ({base}).».
cp.mr.warn.near and cp.cy.body keep their single form: their n is in practice never 1, and an existing test checks the {thr} parameter.
open_issues: The Node performance test battle_ai «≤ 20 ms por ação alienígena» failed once while browser QA was running alongside it and passed on re-run. It is load-sensitive, not a regression.
qa/dogfight_check.mjs «Esc minimiza» waits only 150 ms after Esc. It failed once under parallel QA load and passed when run alone; it could do with a waitForFunction.
python3 http.server processes on ports 47109 and 48709 belong to another agent (the persona r4 «criança» run), so I left them running. My QA scripts kill their own servers.
